scope: Full-size visual inspection of all eight declared Enfusion calibration captures; no neural processing

frames.observation: Almost black frame with a faint small bluish spot near the center. No room surface detail discernible.
Room visible at low brightness, with red/blue walls, three spheres, box, floor and foreground posts. Hard black shadows and coarse colored reflections on the metallic sphere.
Brighter walls and lit sphere halves than LV8, with large black shadow regions and coarse metallic reflections. Fine post shadows have visible stepping.
Brightest case; neutral surfaces and highlights approach white. Geometry remains in place, with hard black shadows and coarse metallic reflection detail retained.
Reserved intermediate intensity: room darker than LV10 and brighter than LV8. Same visible geometry, hard black shadows and coarse metallic reflection.
Reserved intermediate intensity: room brighter than LV10 and darker than LV12. Same visible geometry and remaining shadow/reflection differences.
Second independent LV10 capture has the same visible scene and appearance as the first, including black sphere lower halves, hard shadows and coarse metallic reflections.
Third independent LV10 capture has the same visible scene and appearance as the first two; static similarity does not establish motion stability.
